task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL like 's3://my-bucket.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/key'. Return the region code.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS IAM policy allowing read-only access to a specific S3 bucket named 'company-data'. Include the necessary Effect, Action, and Resource fields.
Write a regular expression that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs. Valid instance IDs follow the format 'i-' followed by 17 hexadecimal characters (e.g., 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8').
